name: Lessons Anew
summary: Mathrengyl Bearwalker sends Alliance druids from Darnassus to Moonglade to learn the ways of cleansing poison. There, Dendrite Starblaze begins their instruction in venom and toxins.

sections.title: A Gift from Cenarius
sections.body: Cenarius teaches druids and blesses them with a bond to the living world. Among his gifts is the power to cleanse venom with a simple incantation. Such power comes with a burden. Before young druids wield it, they learn the hard, ordinary work of fighting toxins without nature's magic.

sections.title: Summons to Nighthaven
sections.body: Mathrengyl Bearwalker trains druids in the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus. Now he sends his student beyond local practice to Moonglade. In Nighthaven, Dendrite Starblaze coordinates the Cenarion Circle's wider efforts. He has practical work for the novice.

sections.title: A Real-World Crisis
sections.body: Nighthaven's initiates face a crisis that is real, not a staged trial or ritual. Auberdine, on the Darkshore coast, suffers a wave of animal poisonings its people cannot stop. Dendrite Starblaze sends the novice to investigate and aid Darkshore. Lives are at stake.

faq.q: Who offers the quest Lessons Anew?
faq.answer: Mathrengyl Bearwalker, the night elf druid trainer in Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave, offers it.

faq.q: Where do I need to go to complete this quest?
faq.answer: Travel to Moonglade and report to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven.

faq.q: Why must druids learn to cure poisons like a layman first?
faq.answer: Druid mentors fear Cenarius's gift of curing venom with an incantation may breed complacency. Learning ordinary ways to confront venom first teaches initiates the burden and suffering poison brings.

faq.q: What problem is taking place in Auberdine?
faq.answer: Auberdine suffers severe animal poisonings along the Darkshore coast. The local night elves cannot cure them and have asked the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade for help.

faq.q: What ability does this quest chain eventually grant?
faq.answer: The chain begins with Power over Poison, which teaches druids Cure Poison, a spell that magically cleanses toxins from allies.

faq.q: Is this quest available to Horde druids?
faq.answer: No. Lessons Anew begins in Darnassus for Alliance druids. Tauren druids receive a parallel beginning in Thunder Bluff, which also sends them to Moonglade to learn to cure poison.

angles.text: As a druid, you move beyond basic shapeshifting and survival to care for the wilds. You learn to lift lethal blights and venoms from nature.
From Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave, you are sent toward the deeper ancestral responsibilities tied to Moonglade and Darkshore.
As an Alliance member, you see how vital druidic aid is to the fragile northern settlements in Darkshore, including Auberdine.
